ko.title: 120일, 모든 도시: 전국적인 광대역 허가 기한을 설정하려는 FCC의 추진 배경

segments.src: ## A National Deadline for Local Permits
segments.tr: ## 지역 허가를 위한 전국적 마감일

segments.src: The Federal Communications Commission is considering a sweeping change to how broadband infrastructure gets approved across the United States: a uniform 120-day "shot clock" that would require local and state governments to act on permit applications for telecom buildouts within that window, or risk having the permit considered automatically granted.
segments.tr: 연방통신위원회(FCC)는 미국 전역에서 광대역 인프라 승인 방식을 뒤흔들 대대적인 변경을 검토하고 있습니다. 이는 지방 및 주 정부가 통신망 구축 허가 신청에 대해 이 기간 내에 처리하지 않을 경우 허가가 자동으로 승인된 것으로 간주될 위험을 감수하도록 요구하는, 일괄적인 120일 "쇼트 클락(shot clock)" 제도입니다.

segments.src: The proposal would also cap the fees municipalities can charge companies to access public rights-of-way — the sidewalks, utility poles, and roadways where fiber lines and small-cell equipment are installed.
segments.tr: 이 제안은 또한 광섬유 케이블과 소형 기지국 장비가 설치되는 인도, 전봇대, 도로 등 공공 부지 접근 권한에 대해 지자체가 기업에 부과할 수 있는 수수료 상한선을 설정할 것입니다.

segments.src: Federal officials backing the plan frame it as a response to a persistent complaint from telecom and internet providers: that inconsistent, sometimes years-long local review processes are one of the biggest bottlenecks slowing the rollout of faster, more reliable internet service, particularly in underserved and rural communities.
segments.tr: 이 계획을 지지하는 연방 관료들은 이를 통신 및 인터넷 제공업체들의 지속적인 불만에 대한 대응으로 규정합니다. 즉, 일관성이 없고 때로는 수년이 걸리는 지역 심사 절차가 특히 소외 지역과 농어촌 지역에서 더 빠르고 신뢰할 수 있는 인터넷 서비스의 보급을 늦추는 가장 큰 병목 현상 중 하나라는 것입니다.

segments.src: Supporters argue that a predictable national timeline would let companies plan builds with more certainty and reduce the cost of expansion, savings they say could eventually be passed on to consumers.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 예측 가능한 전국적 일정을 통해 기업이 더 확실하게 구축 계획을 세우고 확장 비용을 절감할 수 있으며, 이러한 절감 비용은 결국 소비자에게 돌아갈 수 있다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: ## Why Cities Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## 도시들이 반발하는 이유

segments.src: Local governments and organizations representing them, including groups that speak for thousands of cities and counties nationwide, have raised strong objections.
segments.tr: 전국 수천 개의 도시와 카운티를 대변하는 단체를 포함하여 지방 정부와 이들을 대표하는 조직들은 강력한 반대를 제기했습니다.

segments.src: Their core argument is one of authority: rights-of-way have traditionally been managed locally because it is local officials who deal with the practical consequences of construction — torn-up streets, utility conflicts, safety inspections, and coordination with other infrastructure projects like water and sewer work.
segments.tr: 이들의 핵심 주장은 권한에 관한 것입니다. 공공 부지 이용권은 전통적으로 지역에서 관리되어 왔는데, 파헤쳐진 도로, 유틸리티 갈등, 안전 검사, 상하수도 공사와 같은 다른 인프라 프로젝트와의 조율 등 건설의 실제적인 결과물을 처리하는 이들이 바로 지역 관리들이기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Critics of the proposal warn that a rigid 120-day deadline does not account for the wide variation in review complexity across different jurisdictions.
segments.tr: 이 제안의 비판자들은 엄격한 120일 마감일이 관할권마다 다른 심사 복잡성의 큰 차이를 고려하지 않는다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: A small town with a part-time planning staff and a dense historic downtown may need more time to properly vet an application than a large city with a dedicated permitting department.
segments.tr: 시간제 기획 인력이 있고 밀집된 역사적 도심이 있는 소도시의 경우, 전담 허가 부서가 있는 대도시보다 신청서를 적절히 검토하는 데 더 많은 시간이 필요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Municipal advocates also worry that capping fees below what it actually costs a city to review applications and maintain public infrastructure could shift those costs onto local taxpayers instead of the companies benefiting from access to public property.
segments.tr: 지자체 옹호론자들은 또한 도시가 신청서를 검토하고 공공 인프라를 유지하는 데 실제로 드는 비용보다 낮게 수수료 상한선을 설정하면, 공공 자산 접근의 혜택을 받는 기업 대신 지역 납세자들에게 그 비용이 전가될 수 있다고 우려합니다.

segments.src: There is also a practical enforcement question.
segments.tr: 실제 집행에 관한 의문도 존재합니다.

segments.src: If a permit is treated as automatically approved after 120 days regardless of whether a review was completed, some local officials fear that could reduce leverage to negotiate basic safeguards, such as requirements to repair streets after construction or coordinate work to avoid repeated digging in the same location.
segments.tr: 심사 완료 여부와 관계없이 120일이 지나면 허가가 자동으로 승인된 것으로 처리될 경우, 일부 지역 관리들은 공사 후 도로 보수 요건이나 동일 장소의 반복적인굴착을 피하기 위한 공사 조율 같은 기본적인 안전장치를 협상할 수 있는 영향력이 줄어들까 우려합니다.

segments.src: ## The Industry Perspective
segments.tr: ## 업계의 관점

segments.src: Telecom and broadband trade groups have generally welcomed the proposal, describing permitting delays as a genuine obstacle to closing the digital divide, especially in the context of federal and state programs designed to expand high-speed internet access to unserved areas.
segments.tr: 통신 및 광대역 관련 무역 단체들은 일반적으로 이 제안을 환영하며, 허가 지연이 디지털 격차를 해소하는 데 진정한 걸림돌이라고 설명하고 있습니다. 특히 소외 지역으로 고속 인터넷 접근성을 확대하기 위해 고안된 연방 및 주 프로그램의 맥락에서 더욱 그렇습니다.

segments.src: They argue that in many cases, local reviews take far longer than necessary not because of legitimate complexity, but because of understaffed permitting offices, unclear application requirements, or, in some instances, an incentive to extract higher fees before granting approval.
segments.tr: 이들은 많은 경우에 지역 심사가 정당한 복잡성 때문이 아니라 인력이 부족한 허가 부서, 불분명한 신청 요건, 혹은 경우에 따라 승인을 내주기 전에 더 높은 수수료를 챙기려는 동기 때문에 필요한 것보다 훨씬 오래 걸린다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Industry representatives point to the goals of federal broadband expansion initiatives, which set ambitious timelines for connecting unserved households, as evidence that a faster, more standardized permitting process is needed nationwide rather than left to the discretion of thousands of individual local governments.
segments.tr: 업계 대표들은 소외된 가구를 연결하기 위한 의욕적인 일정을 설정하는 연방 광대역 확장 이니셔티브의 목표를 언급하며, 수천 개 개별 지방 정부의 재량에 맡기기보다 전국적으로 더 빠르고 표준화된 허가 절차가 필요하다는 증거로 제시합니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 전망

segments.src: The proposal is still working through the FCC's formal rulemaking process, which typically involves public comment periods where local governments, industry groups, and the public can weigh in before any final rule is adopted.
segments.tr: 이 제안은 아직 FCC의 공식 규정 제정 절차를 거치고 있으며, 이는 일반적으로 최종 규정이 채택되기 전에 지방 정부, 업계 단체, 일반 대중이 의견을 제시할 수 있는 대중 의견 수렴 기간을 포함합니다.

segments.src: Legal challenges are considered likely if a final rule is issued, given long-standing debates over the extent of federal authority to override local control of public rights-of-way.
segments.tr: 공공 부지 이용권에 대한 지방의 통제권을 무시할 수 있는 연방 권한의 범위에 대해 오랜 논쟁이 있어 온 점을 감안할 때, 최종 규정이 발표될 경우 법적 공방이 벌어질 가능성이 높다는 시각이 지배적입니다.

segments.src: For now, the fight over the 120-day clock reflects a broader and recurring tension in U.S.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 120일 기한을 둘러싼 공방은 미국

segments.src: infrastructure policy: balancing the goal of faster, more affordable broadband deployment against the traditional role of local governments in managing what happens on their own streets.
segments.tr: 인프라 정책에서 반복적으로 나타나는 광범위한 긴장감을 반영합니다. 즉, 더 빠르고 저렴한 광대역 보급이라는 목표와 자국 거리에서 일어나는 일을 관리하는 지방 정부의 전통적 역할 사이의 균형을 맞추는 것입니다.

segments.src: How that balance gets struck could shape not just how quickly new broadband lines get built, but who ultimately has a say in approving them.
segments.tr: 그러한 균형이 어떻게 맞춰지느냐에 따라 새로운 광대역망이 얼마나 빨리 구축될 뿐만 아니라, 궁극적으로 누가 그 승인에 발언권을 갖게 될지가 결정될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and reflects the state of a proposed federal rulemaking process, which may change as it moves through further review.*
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로 작성되었으며, 추후 검토 과정에 따라 변경될 수 있는 제안된 연방 규정 제정 절차의 상태를 반영합니다.*

zh.title: 120天，全美每座城市：深入了解联邦通信委员会推动为宽带许可证设定全国统一时钟的举措

segments.src: ## A National Deadline for Local Permits
segments.tr: ## 地方许可证的全国最后期限

segments.src: The Federal Communications Commission is considering a sweeping change to how broadband infrastructure gets approved across the United States: a uniform 120-day "shot clock" that would require local and state governments to act on permit applications for telecom buildouts within that window, or risk having the permit considered automatically granted.
segments.tr: 美国联邦通信委员会（Federal Communications Commission）正在考虑对全美宽带基础设施的审批方式进行重大变革：一项统一的120天“审批时钟”，该时钟将要求地方和州政府在该期限内对电信建设的许可证申请做出处理，否则该许可证将被视为自动批准。

segments.src: The proposal would also cap the fees municipalities can charge companies to access public rights-of-way — the sidewalks, utility poles, and roadways where fiber lines and small-cell equipment are installed.
segments.tr: 该提案还将对市政当局向公司收取以访问公共通行权（即安装光纤线路和小型蜂窝设备的马路、电线杆和道路）的费用设定上限。

segments.src: Federal officials backing the plan frame it as a response to a persistent complaint from telecom and internet providers: that inconsistent, sometimes years-long local review processes are one of the biggest bottlenecks slowing the rollout of faster, more reliable internet service, particularly in underserved and rural communities.
segments.tr: 支持该计划的联邦官员将其描述为对电信和互联网服务提供商长期抱怨的回应：不一致且有时需要数年之久的地方审查流程是减缓更快、更可靠互联网服务普及的最大瓶颈之一，特别是在服务不足的乡村社区。

segments.src: Supporters argue that a predictable national timeline would let companies plan builds with more certainty and reduce the cost of expansion, savings they say could eventually be passed on to consumers.
segments.tr: 支持者认为，可预测的全国时间表可以让公司以更高的确定性规划建设并降低扩张成本，他们称这些节省的成本最终可以转嫁给消费者。

segments.src: ## Why Cities Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## 为什么城市在推迟

segments.src: Local governments and organizations representing them, including groups that speak for thousands of cities and counties nationwide, have raised strong objections.
segments.tr: 地方政府及代表它们的组织（包括代表全国数千个城市和县的团体）提出了强烈的反对意见。

segments.src: Their core argument is one of authority: rights-of-way have traditionally been managed locally because it is local officials who deal with the practical consequences of construction — torn-up streets, utility conflicts, safety inspections, and coordination with other infrastructure projects like water and sewer work.
segments.tr: 他们的核心论点是关于权力的：通行权传统上一直由地方管理，因为正是地方官员在处理建设带来的实际后果——被破坏的街道、公用设施冲突、安全检查以及与水务和排污等其他基础设施项目的协调。

segments.src: Critics of the proposal warn that a rigid 120-day deadline does not account for the wide variation in review complexity across different jurisdictions.
segments.tr: 该提案的批评者警告说，严格的120天截止日期并未考虑到不同司法管辖区之间审查复杂性的巨大差异。

segments.src: A small town with a part-time planning staff and a dense historic downtown may need more time to properly vet an application than a large city with a dedicated permitting department.
segments.tr: 拥有兼职规划人员和密集历史街区的小城镇可能需要更多时间来正确审查申请，而拥有专门审批部门的大城市则不然。

segments.src: Municipal advocates also worry that capping fees below what it actually costs a city to review applications and maintain public infrastructure could shift those costs onto local taxpayers instead of the companies benefiting from access to public property.
segments.tr: 市政倡导者还担心，将费用上限设定在城市实际审查申请和维护公共基础设施的成本以下，可能会将这些成本转嫁给当地纳税人，而不是从访问公共财产中受益的公司。

segments.src: There is also a practical enforcement question.
segments.tr: 还有一个实际的执行问题。

segments.src: If a permit is treated as automatically approved after 120 days regardless of whether a review was completed, some local officials fear that could reduce leverage to negotiate basic safeguards, such as requirements to repair streets after construction or coordinate work to avoid repeated digging in the same location.
segments.tr: 如果无论审查是否完成，许可证在120天后都被视为自动批准，一些地方官员担心这可能会削弱谈判基本保障措施的筹码，例如建设后修复街道的要求，或协调工作以避免在同一地点重复挖掘。

segments.src: ## The Industry Perspective
segments.tr: ## 行业视角

segments.src: Telecom and broadband trade groups have generally welcomed the proposal, describing permitting delays as a genuine obstacle to closing the digital divide, especially in the context of federal and state programs designed to expand high-speed internet access to unserved areas.
segments.tr: 电信和宽带贸易集团普遍对该提案表示欢迎，他们将审批延误描述为缩小数字鸿沟的真正障碍，特别是在旨在扩大未服务地区高速互联网访问的联邦和州计划的背景下。

segments.src: They argue that in many cases, local reviews take far longer than necessary not because of legitimate complexity, but because of understaffed permitting offices, unclear application requirements, or, in some instances, an incentive to extract higher fees before granting approval.
segments.tr: 他们认为，在许多情况下，地方审查花费的时间远远超过必要时间，原因不是合法的复杂性，而是因为审批办公室人手不足、申请要求不明确，或者在某些情况下，存在在批准前榨取更高费用的动机。

segments.src: Industry representatives point to the goals of federal broadband expansion initiatives, which set ambitious timelines for connecting unserved households, as evidence that a faster, more standardized permitting process is needed nationwide rather than left to the discretion of thousands of individual local governments.
segments.tr: 行业代表指出，联邦宽带扩张计划的目标为连接未服务家庭设定了雄心勃勃的时间表，这证明全美需要更快、更标准化的审批流程，而不是交由成千上万个独立的地方政府自行决定。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: The proposal is still working through the FCC's formal rulemaking process, which typically involves public comment periods where local governments, industry groups, and the public can weigh in before any final rule is adopted.
segments.tr: 该提案仍在通过联邦通信委员会的正式规则制定程序推进，该程序通常涉及公众评议期，在此期间地方政府、行业团体和公众可以在任何最终规则通过之前发表意见。

segments.src: Legal challenges are considered likely if a final rule is issued, given long-standing debates over the extent of federal authority to override local control of public rights-of-way.
segments.tr: 鉴于关于联邦权力超越地方对公共通行权控制的程度存在长期争论，如果发布最终规则，法律挑战被认为是可能的。

segments.src: For now, the fight over the 120-day clock reflects a broader and recurring tension in U.S.
segments.tr: 目前，围绕120天时钟的争斗反映了美国政策中更广泛且反复出现的张力：

segments.src: infrastructure policy: balancing the goal of faster, more affordable broadband deployment against the traditional role of local governments in managing what happens on their own streets.
segments.tr: 基础设施政策：在平衡更快、更实惠的宽带部署目标与地方政府管理其自身街道上发生事情的传统角色之间取得平衡。

segments.src: How that balance gets struck could shape not just how quickly new broadband lines get built, but who ultimately has a say in approving them.
segments.tr: 这种平衡如何达成，不仅可以决定新宽带线路建设的速度，还可以决定最终谁对批准它们拥有发言权。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and reflects the state of a proposed federal rulemaking process, which may change as it moves through further review.*
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，反映了拟议联邦规则制定程序的状态，随着进一步审查的进行，该状态可能会发生变化。*

hi.title: 120 दिन, हर शहर: ब्रॉडबैंड परमिट पर राष्ट्रीय घड़ी स्थापित करने के FCC के प्रयास के भीतर

segments.src: ## A National Deadline for Local Permits

segments.tr: फेडरल कम्युनications कमीशन (FCC) पूरे संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में ब्रॉडबैंड बुनियादी ढांचे को मंजूरी मिलने के तरीके में एक व्यापक बदलाव पर विचार कर रहा है: एक समान 120-दिन की "शॉट क्लॉक" जो स्थानीय और राज्य सरकारों को उस अवधि के भीतर दूरसंचार निर्माण के लिए परमिट आवेदनों पर कार्रवाई करने की आवश्यकता होगी, या परमिट को स्वचालित रूप से स्वीकृत माने जाने का जोखिम उठाना होगा।

segments.src: The proposal would also cap the fees municipalities can charge companies to access public rights-of-way — the sidewalks, utility poles, and roadways where fiber lines and small-cell equipment are installed.
segments.tr: यह प्रस्ताव उन शुल्कों पर भी सीमा लगा देगा जो नगर पालिकाएं सार्वजनिक अधिकार-क्षेत्र - फुटपाथ, उपयोगिता खंभे और सड़क मार्ग जहां फाइबर लाइनें और छोटे सेल उपकरण स्थापित किए जाते हैं - तक पहुंचने के लिए कंपनियों से ले सकती हैं।

segments.src: Federal officials backing the plan frame it as a response to a persistent complaint from telecom and internet providers: that inconsistent, sometimes years-long local review processes are one of the biggest bottlenecks slowing the rollout of faster, more reliable internet service, particularly in underserved and rural communities.
segments.tr: इस योजना का समर्थन करने वाले संघीय अधिकारी इसे दूरसंचार और इंटरनेट प्रदाताओं की एक लगातार शिकायत के जवाब के रूप में तैयार करते हैं: कि असंगत, कभी-कभी वर्षों लंबी स्थानीय समीक्षा प्रक्रियाएं तेज, अधिक विश्वसनीय इंटरनेट सेवा के विस्तार को धीमा करने वाली सबसे बड़ी बाधाओं में से एक हैं, विशेष रूप से कम सेवा प्राप्त और ग्रामीण समुदायों में।

segments.src: Supporters argue that a predictable national timeline would let companies plan builds with more certainty and reduce the cost of expansion, savings they say could eventually be passed on to consumers.
segments.tr: समर्थकों का तर्क है कि एक अनुमानित राष्ट्रीय समय सीमा कंपनियों को अधिक निश्चितता के साथ निर्माण की योजना बनाने और विस्तार की लागत को कम करने की अनुमति देगी, ऐसी बचत जो उनका कहना है कि अंततः उपभोक्ताओं को दी जा सकती है।

segments.src: ## Why Cities Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## शहर क्यों पीछे हट रहे हैं

segments.src: Local governments and organizations representing them, including groups that speak for thousands of cities and counties nationwide, have raised strong objections.
segments.tr: स्थानीय सरकारों और उनका प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले संगठनों, जिनमें देश भर के हजारों शहरों और काउंटियों के लिए बोलने वाले समूह शामिल हैं, ने कड़ी आपत्ति जताई है।

segments.src: Their core argument is one of authority: rights-of-way have traditionally been managed locally because it is local officials who deal with the practical consequences of construction — torn-up streets, utility conflicts, safety inspections, and coordination with other infrastructure projects like water and sewer work.
segments.tr: उनकी मुख्य बहस अधिकार की है: अधिकार-क्षेत्रों को पारंपरिक रूप से स्थानीय रूप से प्रबंधित किया गया है क्योंकि यह स्थानीय अधिकारी हैं जो निर्माण के व्यावहारिक परिणामों से निपटते हैं - टूटी हुई सड़कें, उपयोगिता संघर्ष, सुरक्षा निरीक्षण, और पानी और सीवर के काम जैसी अन्य बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं के साथ समन्वय।

segments.src: Critics of the proposal warn that a rigid 120-day deadline does not account for the wide variation in review complexity across different jurisdictions.
segments.tr: प्रस्ताव के आलोचकों ने चेतावनी दी है कि एक कठोर 120-दिन की समय सीमा विभिन्न न्यायक्षेत्रों में समीक्षा की जटिलता में व्यापक भिन्नता को ध्यान में नहीं रखती है।

segments.src: A small town with a part-time planning staff and a dense historic downtown may need more time to properly vet an application than a large city with a dedicated permitting department.
segments.tr: पार्ट-टाइम योजना कर्मचारियों और घने ऐतिहासिक डाउनटाउन वाले एक छोटे शहर को समर्पित परमिट विभाग वाले बड़े शहर की तुलना में आवेदन की ठीक से जांच करने के लिए अधिक समय की आवश्यकता हो सकती है।

segments.src: Municipal advocates also worry that capping fees below what it actually costs a city to review applications and maintain public infrastructure could shift those costs onto local taxpayers instead of the companies benefiting from access to public property.
segments.tr: नगर निगम के अधिवक्ताओं को यह भी चिंता है कि शुल्कों को उस लागत से नीचे सीमित करना जो वास्तव में एक शहर को आवेदनों की समीक्षा करने और सार्वजनिक बुनियादी ढांचे को बनाए रखने के लिए खर्च होती है, सार्वजनिक संपत्ति तक पहुंच से लाभान्वित होने वाली कंपनियों के बजाय उन लागतों को स्थानीय करदाताओं पर स्थानांतरित कर सकती है।

segments.src: There is also a practical enforcement question.
segments.tr: एक व्यावहारिक प्रवर्तन प्रश्न भी है।

segments.src: If a permit is treated as automatically approved after 120 days regardless of whether a review was completed, some local officials fear that could reduce leverage to negotiate basic safeguards, such as requirements to repair streets after construction or coordinate work to avoid repeated digging in the same location.
segments.tr: यदि समीक्षा पूरी होने के बावजूद 120 दिनों के बाद परमिट को स्वचालित रूप से स्वीकृत माना जाता है, तो कुछ स्थानीय अधिकारियों को डर है कि इससे बुनियादी सुरक्षा उपायों, जैसे निर्माण के बाद सड़कों की मरम्मत की आवश्यकताएं या एक ही स्थान पर बार-बार खुदाई से बचने के काम का समन्वय करने की आवश्यकताओं पर बातचीत करने की लीवरेज कम हो सकती है।

segments.src: ## The Industry Perspective
segments.tr: ## उद्योग परिप्रेक्ष्य

segments.src: Telecom and broadband trade groups have generally welcomed the proposal, describing permitting delays as a genuine obstacle to closing the digital divide, especially in the context of federal and state programs designed to expand high-speed internet access to unserved areas.
segments.tr: दूरसंचार और ब्रॉडबैंड व्यापार समूहों ने आम तौर पर इस प्रस्ताव का स्वागत किया है, परमिट में देरी को डिजिटल विभाजन को पाटने के लिए एक वास्तविक बाधा के रूप में वर्णित किया है, विशेष रूप से असंचित क्षेत्रों में हाई-स्पीड इंटरनेट पहुंच का विस्तार करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए संघीय और राज्य कार्यक्रमों के संदर्भ में।

segments.src: They argue that in many cases, local reviews take far longer than necessary not because of legitimate complexity, but because of understaffed permitting offices, unclear application requirements, or, in some instances, an incentive to extract higher fees before granting approval.
segments.tr: उन का तर्क है कि कई मामलों में, स्थानीय समीक्षाएं वैध जटिलता के कारण नहीं, बल्कि कम कर्मचारियों वाले परमिट कार्यालयों, अस्पष्ट आवेदन आवश्यकताओं, या, कुछ मामलों में, अनुमोदन देने से पहले उच्च शुल्क निकालने के प्रोत्साहन के कारण आवश्यक से कहीं अधिक समय लेती हैं।

segments.src: Industry representatives point to the goals of federal broadband expansion initiatives, which set ambitious timelines for connecting unserved households, as evidence that a faster, more standardized permitting process is needed nationwide rather than left to the discretion of thousands of individual local governments.
segments.tr: उद्योग के प्रतिनिधि संघीय ब्रॉडबैंड विस्तार पहल के लक्ष्यों की ओर इशारा करते हैं, जो असंचित परिवारों को जोड़ने के लिए महत्वाकांक्षी समय सीमा निर्धारित करते हैं, इस बात के प्रमाण के रूप में कि हजारों व्यक्तिगत स्थानीय सरकारों के विवेक पर छोड़ने के बजाय देश भर में एक तेज, अधिक मानकीकृत परमिट प्रक्रिया की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होता है

segments.src: The proposal is still working through the FCC's formal rulemaking process, which typically involves public comment periods where local governments, industry groups, and the public can weigh in before any final rule is adopted.
segments.tr: यह प्रस्ताव अभी भी FCC की औपचारिक नियम-निर्माण प्रक्रिया से गुजर रहा है, जिसमें आमतौर पर सार्वजनिक टिप्पणी अवधि शामिल होती है जहाँ किसी भी अंतिम नियम को अपनाने से पहले स्थानीय सरकारें, उद्योग समूह और जनता अपनी राय दे सकती हैं।

segments.src: Legal challenges are considered likely if a final rule is issued, given long-standing debates over the extent of federal authority to override local control of public rights-of-way.
segments.tr: सार्वजनिक अधिकार-क्षेत्र के स्थानीय नियंत्रण को ओवरराइड करने के लिए संघीय प्राधिकरण की सीमा पर लंबे समय से चली आ रही बहस को देखते हुए, यदि कोई अंतिम नियम जारी किया जाता है तो कानूनी चुनौतियों को संभावित माना जाता है।

segments.src: For now, the fight over the 120-day clock reflects a broader and recurring tension in U.S.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, 120-दिन की घड़ी को लेकर लड़ाई अमेरिकी में एक व्यापक और आवर्ती तनाव को दर्शाती है।

segments.src: infrastructure policy: balancing the goal of faster, more affordable broadband deployment against the traditional role of local governments in managing what happens on their own streets.
segments.tr: बुनियादी ढांचा नीति: तेज, अधिक किफायती ब्रॉडबैंड तैनाती के लक्ष्य को अपनी सड़कों पर क्या होता है इसे प्रबंधित करने में स्थानीय सरकारों की पारंपरिक भूमिका के साथ संतुलित करना।

segments.src: How that balance gets struck could shape not just how quickly new broadband lines get built, but who ultimately has a say in approving them.
segments.tr: यह संतुलन कैसे बनता है, यह न केवल इस बात को आकार दे सकता है कि कितनी जल्दी नई ब्रॉडबैंड लाइनें बनती हैं, बल्कि अंततः उन्हें मंजूरी देने में किसकी बात चलती है।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and reflects the state of a proposed federal rulemaking process, which may change as it moves through further review.*
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य सूचना के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और प्रस्तावित संघीय नियम-निर्माण प्रक्रिया की स्थिति को दर्शाता है, जो आगे की समीक्षा के माध्यम से आगे बढ़ने पर बदल सकती है।*

es.title: 120 días, cada ciudad: Detrás del impulso de la FCC para establecer un plazo nacional para los permisos de banda ancha

segments.src: ## A National Deadline for Local Permits
segments.tr: ## Un plazo nacional para los permisos locales

segments.src: The Federal Communications Commission is considering a sweeping change to how broadband infrastructure gets approved across the United States: a uniform 120-day "shot clock" that would require local and state governments to act on permit applications for telecom buildouts within that window, or risk having the permit considered automatically granted.
segments.tr: La Comisión Federal de Comunicaciones (FCC) está considerando un cambio radical en la forma en que se aprueba la infraestructura de banda ancha en todo Estados Unidos: un "reloj de cuenta regresiva" uniforme de 120 días que exigiría a los gobiernos locales y estatales actuar sobre las solicitudes de permisos para despliegues de telecomunicaciones dentro de ese plazo, o arriesgarse a que el permiso se considere aprobado automáticamente.

segments.src: The proposal would also cap the fees municipalities can charge companies to access public rights-of-way — the sidewalks, utility poles, and roadways where fiber lines and small-cell equipment are installed.
segments.tr: La propuesta también pondría un límite a las tarifas que los municipios pueden cobrar a las empresas para acceder a los derechos de vía públicos: las aceras, los postes de servicios públicos y las calzadas donde se instalan las líneas de fibra óptica y los equipos de celdas pequeñas.

segments.src: Federal officials backing the plan frame it as a response to a persistent complaint from telecom and internet providers: that inconsistent, sometimes years-long local review processes are one of the biggest bottlenecks slowing the rollout of faster, more reliable internet service, particularly in underserved and rural communities.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios federales que respaldan el plan lo enmarcan como una respuesta a una queja persistente de los proveedores de telecomunicaciones e internet: que los procesos de revisión local inconsistentes, que a veces duran años, son uno de los mayores cuellos de botella que ralentizan el despliegue de un servicio de internet más rápido y confiable, particularmente en comunidades desatendidas y rurales.

segments.src: Supporters argue that a predictable national timeline would let companies plan builds with more certainty and reduce the cost of expansion, savings they say could eventually be passed on to consumers.
segments.tr: Los partidarios argumentan que un cronograma nacional predecible permitiría a las empresas planificar construcciones con mayor certeza y reducir el costo de expansión, ahorros que, según dicen, eventualmente podrían trasladarse a los consumidores.

segments.src: ## Why Cities Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## Por qué las ciudades se están resistiendo

segments.src: Local governments and organizations representing them, including groups that speak for thousands of cities and counties nationwide, have raised strong objections.
segments.tr: Los gobiernos locales y las organizaciones que los representan, incluidos grupos que hablan por miles de ciudades y condados en todo el país, han planteado objeciones firmes.

segments.src: Their core argument is one of authority: rights-of-way have traditionally been managed locally because it is local officials who deal with the practical consequences of construction — torn-up streets, utility conflicts, safety inspections, and coordination with other infrastructure projects like water and sewer work.
segments.tr: Su argumento central es el de la autoridad: los derechos de vía se han gestionado tradicionalmente a nivel local porque son los funcionarios locales quienes lidian con las consecuencias prácticas de la construcción: calles rotas, conflictos de servicios públicos, inspecciones de seguridad y coordinación con otros proyectos de infraestructura como obras de agua y alcantarillado.

segments.src: Critics of the proposal warn that a rigid 120-day deadline does not account for the wide variation in review complexity across different jurisdictions.
segments.tr: Los críticos de la propuesta advierten que un plazo rígido de 120 días no tiene en cuenta la gran variación en la complejidad de las revisiones entre las diferentes jurisdicciones.

segments.src: A small town with a part-time planning staff and a dense historic downtown may need more time to properly vet an application than a large city with a dedicated permitting department.
segments.tr: Un pueblo pequeño con personal de planificación a tiempo parcial y un centro histórico denso puede necesitar más tiempo para evaluar adecuadamente una solicitud que una gran ciudad con un departamento de permisos dedicado.

segments.src: Municipal advocates also worry that capping fees below what it actually costs a city to review applications and maintain public infrastructure could shift those costs onto local taxpayers instead of the companies benefiting from access to public property.
segments.tr: A los defensores municipales también les preocupa que limitar las tarifas por debajo de lo que realmente le cuesta a una ciudad revisar las solicitudes y mantener la infraestructura pública pueda trasladar esos costos a los contribuyentes locales en lugar de a las empresas que se benefician del acceso a la propiedad pública.

segments.src: There is also a practical enforcement question.
segments.tr: También hay una cuestión práctica de aplicación.

segments.src: If a permit is treated as automatically approved after 120 days regardless of whether a review was completed, some local officials fear that could reduce leverage to negotiate basic safeguards, such as requirements to repair streets after construction or coordinate work to avoid repeated digging in the same location.
segments.tr: Si un permiso se trata como aprobado automáticamente después de 120 días, independientemente de si se completó una revisión, algunos funcionarios locales temen que eso pueda reducir la capacidad de negociación para establecer salvaguardas básicas, como los requisitos para reparar las calles después de la construcción o coordinar los trabajos para evitar excavaciones repetidas en el mismo lugar.

segments.src: ## The Industry Perspective
segments.tr: ## La perspectiva de la industria

segments.src: Telecom and broadband trade groups have generally welcomed the proposal, describing permitting delays as a genuine obstacle to closing the digital divide, especially in the context of federal and state programs designed to expand high-speed internet access to unserved areas.
segments.tr: Los grupos comerciales de telecomunicaciones y banda ancha han recibido la propuesta con agrado en general, describiendo los retrasos en los permisos como un obstáculo genuino para cerrar la brecha digital, especialmente en el contexto de programas federales y estatales diseñados para expandir el acceso a internet de alta velocidad a áreas no atendidas.

segments.src: They argue that in many cases, local reviews take far longer than necessary not because of legitimate complexity, but because of understaffed permitting offices, unclear application requirements, or, in some instances, an incentive to extract higher fees before granting approval.
segments.tr: Argumentan que, en muchos casos, las revisiones locales toman mucho más tiempo del necesario no debido a una complejidad legítima, sino a oficinas de permisos con poco personal, requisitos de solicitud poco claros o, en algunos casos, un incentivo para extraer tarifas más altas antes de otorgar la aprobación.

segments.src: Industry representatives point to the goals of federal broadband expansion initiatives, which set ambitious timelines for connecting unserved households, as evidence that a faster, more standardized permitting process is needed nationwide rather than left to the discretion of thousands of individual local governments.
segments.tr: Los representantes de la industria señalan los objetivos de las iniciativas federales de expansión de la banda ancha, que establecen cronogramas ambiciosos para conectar a los hogares desatendidos, como evidencia de que se necesita un proceso de permisos más rápido y estandarizado a nivel nacional en lugar de dejarlo a la discreción de miles de gobiernos locales individuales.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sucede a continuación

segments.src: The proposal is still working through the FCC's formal rulemaking process, which typically involves public comment periods where local governments, industry groups, and the public can weigh in before any final rule is adopted.
segments.tr: La propuesta todavía está avanzando en el proceso formal de elaboración de normas de la FCC, que típicamente incluye períodos de comentarios públicos donde los gobiernos locales, los grupos de la industria y el público pueden opinar antes de que se adopte cualquier norma definitiva.

segments.src: Legal challenges are considered likely if a final rule is issued, given long-standing debates over the extent of federal authority to override local control of public rights-of-way.
segments.tr: Se consideran probables impugnaciones legales si se emite una norma definitiva, dados los debates de larga data sobre el alcance de la autoridad federal para anular el control local de los derechos de vía públicos.

segments.src: For now, the fight over the 120-day clock reflects a broader and recurring tension in U.S.
segments.tr: Por ahora, la lucha por el reloj de 120 días refleja una tensión más amplia y recurrente en la política de infraestructura de EE.

segments.src: infrastructure policy: balancing the goal of faster, more affordable broadband deployment against the traditional role of local governments in managing what happens on their own streets.
segments.tr: UU.: equilibrar el objetivo de un despliegue de banda ancha más rápido y asequible con el papel tradicional de los gobiernos locales en la gestión de lo que sucede en sus propias calles.

ar.title: 120 يوماً، في كل مدينة: نظرة على مساعي لجنة الاتصالات الفيدرالية (FCC) لتحديد موعد نهائي وطني لتصاريح النطاق العريض

segments.src: ## A National Deadline for Local Permits
segments.tr: ## موعد نهائي وطني للتصاريح المحلية

segments.src: The Federal Communications Commission is considering a sweeping change to how broadband infrastructure gets approved across the United States: a uniform 120-day "shot clock" that would require local and state governments to act on permit applications for telecom buildouts within that window, or risk having the permit considered automatically granted.
segments.tr: تدرس لجنة الاتصالات الفيدرالية تغييراً شاملاً في كيفية الموافقة على البنية التحتية للنطاق العريض في جميع أنحاء الولايات المتحدة: "ساعة توقيت" موحدة مدتها 120 يوماً تتطلب من الحكومات المحلية وحكومات الولايات البت في طلبات التصاريح الخاصة بإنشاءات الاتصالات خلال تلك الفترة، وإلا فإنها تخاطر باعتبار التصريح مقبولاً تلقائياً.

segments.src: The proposal would also cap the fees municipalities can charge companies to access public rights-of-way — the sidewalks, utility poles, and roadways where fiber lines and small-cell equipment are installed.
segments.tr: كما سيضع هذا الاقتراح سقفاً للرسوم التي يمكن للبلديات فرضها على الشركات للوصول إلى حقوق المرور العامة - وهي الأرصفة، وأعمدة المرافق، والطرق التي يتم تركيب خطوط الألياف الضوئية ومعدات الخلايا الصغيرة فيها.

segments.src: Federal officials backing the plan frame it as a response to a persistent complaint from telecom and internet providers: that inconsistent, sometimes years-long local review processes are one of the biggest bottlenecks slowing the rollout of faster, more reliable internet service, particularly in underserved and rural communities.
segments.tr: يؤطر المسؤولون الفيدراليون الذين يدعمون الخطة ذلك كاستجابة لشكوى مستمرة من شركات الاتصالات ومزودي خدمات الإنترنت: وهي أن عمليات المراجعة المحلية غير المتسقة، والتي تستغرق أحياناً سنوات، تعد واحدة من أكبر الاختناقات التي تبطئ طرح خدمة إنترنت أسرع وأكثر موثوقية، لا سيما في المجتمعات المحرومة والريفية.

segments.src: Supporters argue that a predictable national timeline would let companies plan builds with more certainty and reduce the cost of expansion, savings they say could eventually be passed on to consumers.
segments.tr: يجادل المؤيدون بأن جدولاً زمنياً وطنياً يمكن التنبؤ به سيسمح للشركات بتخطيط عمليات البناء بمزيد من اليقين وتقليل تكلفة التوسع، وهي وفورات يقولون إنه يمكن نقلها في النهاية إلى المستهلكين.

segments.src: ## Why Cities Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## لماذا تعارض المدن هذا التوجه

segments.src: Local governments and organizations representing them, including groups that speak for thousands of cities and counties nationwide, have raised strong objections.
segments.tr: أبدت الحكومات المحلية والمنظمات التي تمثلها، بما في ذلك المجموعات التي تتحدث باسم آلاف المدن والمقاطعات على مستوى البلاد، اعتراضات قوية.

segments.src: Their core argument is one of authority: rights-of-way have traditionally been managed locally because it is local officials who deal with the practical consequences of construction — torn-up streets, utility conflicts, safety inspections, and coordination with other infrastructure projects like water and sewer work.
segments.tr: حجتهم الأساسية تتعلق بالسلطة: لطالما تمت إدارة حقوق المرور محلياً لأن المسؤولين المحليين هم من يتعاملون مع العواقب العملية للبناء - مثل الشوارع المحفورة، وتعارض المرافق، وفحوصات السلامة، والتنسيق مع مشاريع البنية التحتية الأخرى مثل أعمال المياه والصرف الصحي.

segments.src: Critics of the proposal warn that a rigid 120-day deadline does not account for the wide variation in review complexity across different jurisdictions.
segments.tr: يحذر منتقدو الاقتراح من أن الموعد النهائي الصارم البالغ 120 يوماً لا يأخذ في الاعتبار التباين الكبير في تعقيد المراجعة عبر الولايات القضائية المختلفة.

segments.src: A small town with a part-time planning staff and a dense historic downtown may need more time to properly vet an application than a large city with a dedicated permitting department.
segments.tr: قد تحتاج بلدة صغيرة لديها موظفو تخطيط يعملون بدوام جزئي ووسط مدينة تاريخي مزدحم إلى وقت أطول للتدقيق في طلب ما مقارنة بمدينة كبيرة لديها قسم مخصص للتصاريح.

segments.src: Municipal advocates also worry that capping fees below what it actually costs a city to review applications and maintain public infrastructure could shift those costs onto local taxpayers instead of the companies benefiting from access to public property.
segments.tr: كما يخشى المدافعون عن البلديات أن يؤدي وضع سقف للرسوم يقل عن التكلفة الفعلية التي تتكبدها المدينة لمراجعة الطلبات وصيانة البنية التحتية العامة إلى تحويل تلك التكاليف إلى دافعي الضرائب المحليين بدلاً من الشركات التي تستفيد من الوصول إلى الممتلكات العامة.

segments.src: There is also a practical enforcement question.
segments.tr: هناك أيضاً مسألة عملية تتعلق بالتنفيذ.

segments.src: If a permit is treated as automatically approved after 120 days regardless of whether a review was completed, some local officials fear that could reduce leverage to negotiate basic safeguards, such as requirements to repair streets after construction or coordinate work to avoid repeated digging in the same location.
segments.tr: إذا تم التعامل مع التصريح على أنه مقبول تلقائياً بعد 120 يوماً بغض النظر عما إذا كانت المراجعة قد اكتملت أم لا، يخشى بعض المسؤولين المحليين أن يؤدي ذلك إلى تقليل القدرة على التفاوض بشأن الضمانات الأساسية، مثل متطلبات إصلاح الشوارع بعد البناء أو تنسيق العمل لتجنب الحفر المتكرر في نفس الموقع.

segments.src: ## The Industry Perspective
segments.tr: ## وجهة نظر القطاع

segments.src: Telecom and broadband trade groups have generally welcomed the proposal, describing permitting delays as a genuine obstacle to closing the digital divide, especially in the context of federal and state programs designed to expand high-speed internet access to unserved areas.
segments.tr: رحبت المجموعات التجارية للاتصالات والنطاق العريض بشكل عام بالاقتراح، واصفة تأخيرات التصاريح بأنها عقبة حقيقية أمام سد الفجوة الرقمية، خاصة في سياق البرامج الفيدرالية وبرامج الولايات المصممة لتوسيع الوصول إلى الإنترنت عالي السرعة إلى المناطق غير المخدومة.

segments.src: They argue that in many cases, local reviews take far longer than necessary not because of legitimate complexity, but because of understaffed permitting offices, unclear application requirements, or, in some instances, an incentive to extract higher fees before granting approval.
segments.tr: يجادلون بأنه في كثير من الحالات، تستغرق المراجعات المحلية وقتاً أطول بكثير مما هو ضروري ليس بسبب التعقيد المشروع، ولكن بسبب نقص الموظفين في مكاتب التصاريح، أو متطلبات التقديم غير الواضحة، أو في بعض الحالات، وجود حافز لاستخراج رسوم أعلى قبل منح الموافقة.

segments.src: Industry representatives point to the goals of federal broadband expansion initiatives, which set ambitious timelines for connecting unserved households, as evidence that a faster, more standardized permitting process is needed nationwide rather than left to the discretion of thousands of individual local governments.
segments.tr: يشير ممثلو القطاع إلى أهداف مبادرات توسيع النطاق العريض الفيدرالية، التي تحدد جداول زمنية طموحة لربط الأسر غير المخدومة، كدليل على الحاجة إلى عملية تصاريح أسرع وأكثر توحيداً على مستوى البلاد بدلاً من تركها لتقدير آلاف الحكومات المحلية الفردية.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: The proposal is still working through the FCC's formal rulemaking process, which typically involves public comment periods where local governments, industry groups, and the public can weigh in before any final rule is adopted.
segments.tr: لا يزال الاقتراح يمر عبر عملية وضع القواعد الرسمية للجنة الاتصالات الفيدرالية (FCC)، والتي تتضمن عادةً فترات تعليق عامة حيث يمكن للحكومات المحلية والمجموعات الصناعية والجمهور إبداء آرائهم قبل اعتماد أي قاعدة نهائية.

segments.src: Legal challenges are considered likely if a final rule is issued, given long-standing debates over the extent of federal authority to override local control of public rights-of-way.
segments.tr: من المحتمل حدوث تحديات قانونية إذا تم إصدار قاعدة نهائية، نظراً للنقاشات الطويلة حول مدى السلطة الفيدرالية في تجاوز السيطرة المحلية على حقوق المرور العامة.

segments.src: For now, the fight over the 120-day clock reflects a broader and recurring tension in U.S.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يعكس الصراع حول ساعة الـ 120 يوماً توتراً أوسع ومتكرراً في سياسة البنية التحتية الأمريكية:

segments.src: infrastructure policy: balancing the goal of faster, more affordable broadband deployment against the traditional role of local governments in managing what happens on their own streets.
segments.tr: الموازنة بين هدف نشر النطاق العريض بشكل أسرع وبأسعار معقولة مقابل الدور التقليدي للحكومات المحلية في إدارة ما يحدث في شوارعها.

segments.src: How that balance gets struck could shape not just how quickly new broadband lines get built, but who ultimately has a say in approving them.
segments.tr: كيفية تحقيق هذا التوازن قد لا تشكل فقط مدى سرعة بناء خطوط النطاق العريض الجديدة، بل من سيكون له القول الفصل في الموافقة عليها.

fr.title: 120 jours, chaque ville : dans les coulisses de la volonté de la FCC d'imposer un délai national pour les permis de très haut débit

segments.src: ## A National Deadline for Local Permits
segments.tr: ## Un délai national pour les permis locaux

segments.src: The Federal Communications Commission is considering a sweeping change to how broadband infrastructure gets approved across the United States: a uniform 120-day "shot clock" that would require local and state governments to act on permit applications for telecom buildouts within that window, or risk having the permit considered automatically granted.
segments.tr: La Commission fédérale des communications examine un changement radical dans la manière dont l'infrastructure du très haut débit est approuvée à travers les États-Unis : un « délai d'expiration » uniforme de 120 jours qui obligerait les gouvernements locaux et étatiques à statuer sur les demandes de permis pour le déploiement des télécommunications dans ce laps de temps, sous peine de voir le permis considéré comme automatiquement accordé.

segments.src: The proposal would also cap the fees municipalities can charge companies to access public rights-of-way — the sidewalks, utility poles, and roadways where fiber lines and small-cell equipment are installed.
segments.tr: La proposition plafonnerait également les frais que les municipalités peuvent facturer aux entreprises pour accéder aux emprises publiques — les trottoirs, les poteaux électriques et les routes où les lignes de fibre optique et les équipements de petites cellules sont installés.

segments.src: Federal officials backing the plan frame it as a response to a persistent complaint from telecom and internet providers: that inconsistent, sometimes years-long local review processes are one of the biggest bottlenecks slowing the rollout of faster, more reliable internet service, particularly in underserved and rural communities.
segments.tr: Les responsables fédéraux qui soutiennent ce plan le présentent comme une réponse à une plainte persistante des fournisseurs de télécommunications et d'Internet : les processus d'examen locaux incohérents, qui durent parfois des années, constituent l'un des plus grands goulets d'étranglement ralentissant le déploiement d'un service Internet plus rapide et plus fiable, en particulier dans les communautés mal desservies et rurales.

segments.src: Supporters argue that a predictable national timeline would let companies plan builds with more certainty and reduce the cost of expansion, savings they say could eventually be passed on to consumers.
segments.tr: Les partisans soutiennent qu'un calendrier national prévisible permettrait aux entreprises de planifier leurs chantiers avec plus de certitude et de réduire le coût de l'expansion, des économies qui, selon eux, pourraient finalement être répercutées sur les consommateurs.

segments.src: ## Why Cities Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les villes font de la résistance

segments.src: Local governments and organizations representing them, including groups that speak for thousands of cities and counties nationwide, have raised strong objections.
segments.tr: Les gouvernements locaux et les organisations qui les représentent, y compris des groupes qui parlent au nom de milliers de villes et de comtés à travers le pays, ont soulevé de fortes objections.

segments.src: Their core argument is one of authority: rights-of-way have traditionally been managed locally because it is local officials who deal with the practical consequences of construction — torn-up streets, utility conflicts, safety inspections, and coordination with other infrastructure projects like water and sewer work.
segments.tr: Leur argument central est celui de l'autorité : les emprises ont traditionnellement été gérées au niveau local parce que ce sont les fonctionnaires locaux qui font face aux conséquences pratiques de la construction — rues éventrées, conflits de services publics, inspections de sécurité et coordination avec d'autres projets d'infrastructure comme les travaux d'eau et d'égouts.

segments.src: Critics of the proposal warn that a rigid 120-day deadline does not account for the wide variation in review complexity across different jurisdictions.
segments.tr: Les critiques de la proposition avertissent qu'un délai rigide de 120 jours ne tient pas compte de la grande diversité de complexité des examens selon les différentes juridictions.

segments.src: A small town with a part-time planning staff and a dense historic downtown may need more time to properly vet an application than a large city with a dedicated permitting department.
segments.tr: Une petite ville dotée d'un personnel de planification à temps partiel et d'un centre historique dense peut avoir besoin de plus de temps pour examiner correctement une demande qu'une grande ville disposant d'un service des permis dédié.

segments.src: Municipal advocates also worry that capping fees below what it actually costs a city to review applications and maintain public infrastructure could shift those costs onto local taxpayers instead of the companies benefiting from access to public property.
segments.tr: Les défenseurs des municipalités s'inquiètent également du fait que le plafonnement des frais en dessous de ce qu'il en coûte réellement à une ville pour examiner les demandes et entretenir les infrastructures publiques pourrait reporter ces coûts sur les contribuables locaux au lieu des entreprises qui bénéficient de l'accès à la propriété publique.

segments.src: There is also a practical enforcement question.
segments.tr: Il y a aussi une question d'application pratique.

segments.src: If a permit is treated as automatically approved after 120 days regardless of whether a review was completed, some local officials fear that could reduce leverage to negotiate basic safeguards, such as requirements to repair streets after construction or coordinate work to avoid repeated digging in the same location.
segments.tr: Si un permis est traité comme automatiquement approuvé après 120 jours, que l'examen ait été achevé ou non, certains fonctionnaires locaux craignent que cela ne réduise leur marge de négociation pour imposer des garanties de base, telles que l'obligation de réparer les rues après les travaux ou de coordonner les chantiers pour éviter des creusements répétés au même endroit.

segments.src: ## The Industry Perspective
segments.tr: ## La perspective de l'industrie

segments.src: Telecom and broadband trade groups have generally welcomed the proposal, describing permitting delays as a genuine obstacle to closing the digital divide, especially in the context of federal and state programs designed to expand high-speed internet access to unserved areas.
segments.tr: Les groupes professionnels des télécommunications et du très haut débit ont généralement bien accueilli la proposition, décrivant les retards d'octroi de permis comme un véritable obstacle à la réduction de la fracture numérique, en particulier dans le contexte des programmes fédéraux et étatiques conçus pour étendre l'accès à Internet haut débit aux zones non desservies.

segments.src: They argue that in many cases, local reviews take far longer than necessary not because of legitimate complexity, but because of understaffed permitting offices, unclear application requirements, or, in some instances, an incentive to extract higher fees before granting approval.
segments.tr: Ils soutiennent que, dans de nombreux cas, les examens locaux prennent beaucoup plus de temps que nécessaire non pas en raison d'une complexité légitime, mais à cause de bureaux de délivrance des permis manquant de personnel, d'exigences de demande peu claires ou, dans certains cas, d'une incitation à extraire des frais plus élevés avant d'accorder l'approbation.

segments.src: Industry representatives point to the goals of federal broadband expansion initiatives, which set ambitious timelines for connecting unserved households, as evidence that a faster, more standardized permitting process is needed nationwide rather than left to the discretion of thousands of individual local governments.
segments.tr: Les représentants de l'industrie soulignent que les objectifs des initiatives fédérales d'expansion du très haut débit, qui fixent des calendriers ambitieux pour connecter les foyers non desservis, prouvent qu'un processus d'octroi de permis plus rapide et plus standardisé est nécessaire à l'échelle nationale plutôt que d'être laissé à la discrétion de milliers de gouvernements locaux individuels.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite

segments.src: The proposal is still working through the FCC's formal rulemaking process, which typically involves public comment periods where local governments, industry groups, and the public can weigh in before any final rule is adopted.
segments.tr: La proposition poursuit son chemin dans le processus officiel d'établissement des règles de la FCC, qui implique généralement des périodes de consultation publique où les gouvernements locaux, les groupes industriels et le public peuvent donner leur avis avant qu'une règle définitive ne soit adoptée.

segments.src: Legal challenges are considered likely if a final rule is issued, given long-standing debates over the extent of federal authority to override local control of public rights-of-way.
segments.tr: Des recours juridiques sont considérés comme probables si une règle définitive est émise, étant donné les débats de longue date sur l'étendue de l'autorité fédérale pour supplanter le contrôle local des emprises publiques.

segments.src: For now, the fight over the 120-day clock reflects a broader and recurring tension in U.S.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, la lutte autour du délai de 120 jours reflète une tension plus large et récurrente dans la politique américaine

segments.tr: en matière d'infrastructures : concilier l'objectif d'un déploiement du très haut débit plus rapide et plus abordable avec le rôle traditionnel des gouvernements locaux dans la gestion de ce qui se passe sur leurs propres rues.

segments.src: How that balance gets struck could shape not just how quickly new broadband lines get built, but who ultimately has a say in approving them.
segments.tr: La manière dont cet équilibre sera trouvé pourrait façonner non seulement la vitesse à laquelle les nouvelles lignes de très haut débit sont construites, mais aussi qui a finalement son mot à dire pour les approuver.

segments.tr: Uma pequena cidade com uma equipe de planejamento de meio período e um centro histórico denso pode precisar de mais tempo para avaliar adequadamente um pedido do que uma cidade grande com um departamento de licenciamento dedicado.

segments.src: Municipal advocates also worry that capping fees below what it actually costs a city to review applications and maintain public infrastructure could shift those costs onto local taxpayers instead of the companies benefiting from access to public property.
segments.tr: Os defensores municipais também temem que limitar as taxas abaixo do que realmente custa para uma cidade analisar os pedidos e manter a infraestrutura pública possa transferir esses custos para os contribuintes locais, em vez de para as empresas que se beneficiam do acesso à propriedade pública.

segments.src: There is also a practical enforcement question.
segments.tr: Há também uma questão prática de aplicação.

segments.src: If a permit is treated as automatically approved after 120 days regardless of whether a review was completed, some local officials fear that could reduce leverage to negotiate basic safeguards, such as requirements to repair streets after construction or coordinate work to avoid repeated digging in the same location.
segments.tr: Se uma licença for tratada como automaticamente aprovada após 120 dias, independentemente de a revisão ter sido concluída, alguns funcionários locais temem que isso possa reduzir a capacidade de negociar salvaguardas básicas, como requisitos para reparar ruas após a construção ou coordenar o trabalho para evitar escavações repetidas no mesmo local.

segments.src: ## The Industry Perspective
segments.tr: ## A perspectiva da indústria

segments.src: Telecom and broadband trade groups have generally welcomed the proposal, describing permitting delays as a genuine obstacle to closing the digital divide, especially in the context of federal and state programs designed to expand high-speed internet access to unserved areas.
segments.tr: Grupos comerciais de telecomunicações e banda larga geralmente receberam bem a proposta, descrevendo os atrasos no licenciamento como um obstáculo genuíno para fechar a exclusão digital, especialmente no contexto de programas federais e estaduais projetados para expandir o acesso à internet de alta velocidade para áreas não atendidas.

segments.src: They argue that in many cases, local reviews take far longer than necessary not because of legitimate complexity, but because of understaffed permitting offices, unclear application requirements, or, in some instances, an incentive to extract higher fees before granting approval.
segments.tr: Eles argumentam que, em muitos casos, as revisões locais levam muito mais tempo do que o necessário, não por causa de complexidade legítima, mas por causa de escritórios de licenciamento com falta de pessoal, requisitos de inscrição pouco claros ou, em alguns casos, um incentivo para extrair taxas mais altas antes de conceder a aprovação.

segments.src: Industry representatives point to the goals of federal broadband expansion initiatives, which set ambitious timelines for connecting unserved households, as evidence that a faster, more standardized permitting process is needed nationwide rather than left to the discretion of thousands of individual local governments.
segments.tr: Representantes da indústria apontam para os objetivos das iniciativas federais de expansão de banda larga, que estabelecem cronogramas ambiciosos para conectar residências não atendidas, como evidência de que um processo de licenciamento mais rápido e padronizado é necessário em todo o país, em vez de ser deixado ao critério de milhares de governos locais individuais.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O que acontece a seguir

segments.src: The proposal is still working through the FCC's formal rulemaking process, which typically involves public comment periods where local governments, industry groups, and the public can weigh in before any final rule is adopted.
segments.tr: A proposta ainda está passando pelo processo formal de regulamentação da FCC, que normalmente envolve períodos de comentários públicos onde governos locais, grupos da indústria e o público podem opinar antes que qualquer regra final seja adotada.

segments.src: Legal challenges are considered likely if a final rule is issued, given long-standing debates over the extent of federal authority to override local control of public rights-of-way.
segments.tr: Desafios legais são considerados prováveis se uma regra final for emitida, dados os debates de longa data sobre a extensão da autoridade federal para substituir o controle local das vias públicas.

segments.src: For now, the fight over the 120-day clock reflects a broader and recurring tension in U.S.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, a luta pelo cronograma de 120 dias reflete uma tensão mais ampla e recorrente na política de infraestrutura dos EUA.

segments.src: infrastructure policy: balancing the goal of faster, more affordable broadband deployment against the traditional role of local governments in managing what happens on their own streets.
segments.tr: infraestrutura: equilibrar o objetivo de uma implementação de banda larga mais rápida e acessível com o papel tradicional dos governos locais no gerenciamento do que acontece em suas próprias ruas.

segments.src: How that balance gets struck could shape not just how quickly new broadband lines get built, but who ultimately has a say in approving them.
segments.tr: Como esse equilíbrio será alcançado pode moldar não apenas a rapidez com que novas linhas de banda larga são construídas, mas quem, em última análise, tem voz na aprovação delas.

in.title: 120 Hari, Setiap Kota: Di Balik Upaya FCC untuk Menetapkan Batas Waktu Nasional bagi Izin Pita Lebar

segments.src: ## A National Deadline for Local Permits
segments.tr: ## Batas Waktu Nasional untuk Izin Lokal

segments.src: The Federal Communications Commission is considering a sweeping change to how broadband infrastructure gets approved across the United States: a uniform 120-day "shot clock" that would require local and state governments to act on permit applications for telecom buildouts within that window, or risk having the permit considered automatically granted.
segments.tr: Komisi Komunikasi Federal (FCC) sedang mempertimbangkan perubahan besar terhadap cara infrastruktur pita lebar disetujui di seluruh Amerika Serikat: "jam hitung mundur" 120 hari yang seragam yang akan mengharuskan pemerintah daerah dan negara bagian untuk menindaklanjuti permohonan izin pembangunan telekomunikasi dalam jangka waktu tersebut, atau berisiko membuat izin tersebut dianggap disetujui secara otomatis.

segments.src: The proposal would also cap the fees municipalities can charge companies to access public rights-of-way — the sidewalks, utility poles, and roadways where fiber lines and small-cell equipment are installed.
segments.tr: Proposal ini juga akan membatasi biaya yang dapat dikenakan oleh pemerintah kota kepada perusahaan untuk mengakses hak jalan umum — trotoar, tiang utilitas, dan jalan raya tempat kabel serat optik dan peralatan seluler kecil dipasang.

segments.src: Federal officials backing the plan frame it as a response to a persistent complaint from telecom and internet providers: that inconsistent, sometimes years-long local review processes are one of the biggest bottlenecks slowing the rollout of faster, more reliable internet service, particularly in underserved and rural communities.
segments.tr: Pejabat federal yang mendukung rencana ini menyebutnya sebagai tanggapan atas keluhan terus-menerus dari penyedia telekomunikasi dan internet: bahwa proses peninjauan lokal yang tidak konsisten dan terkadang memakan waktu bertahun-tahun adalah salah satu hambatan terbesar yang memperlambat peluncuran layanan internet yang lebih cepat dan lebih andal, terutama di komunitas yang kurang terlayani dan pedesaan.

segments.src: Supporters argue that a predictable national timeline would let companies plan builds with more certainty and reduce the cost of expansion, savings they say could eventually be passed on to consumers.
segments.tr: Para pendukung berpendapat bahwa jadwal nasional yang dapat diprediksi akan memungkinkan perusahaan merencanakan pembangunan dengan lebih pasti dan mengurangi biaya ekspansi, penghematan yang menurut mereka pada akhirnya dapat diteruskan kepada konsumen.

segments.src: ## Why Cities Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kota-Kota Menolak

segments.src: Local governments and organizations representing them, including groups that speak for thousands of cities and counties nationwide, have raised strong objections.
segments.tr: Pemerintah daerah dan organisasi yang mewakili mereka, termasuk kelompok yang berbicara untuk ribuan kota dan wilayah di seluruh negeri, telah mengajukan keberatan keras.

segments.src: Their core argument is one of authority: rights-of-way have traditionally been managed locally because it is local officials who deal with the practical consequences of construction — torn-up streets, utility conflicts, safety inspections, and coordination with other infrastructure projects like water and sewer work.
segments.tr: Argumen utama mereka adalah mengenai wewenang: hak jalan secara tradisional dikelola secara lokal karena pejabat lokallah yang menangani konsekuensi praktis dari konstruksi — jalan yang dibongkar, konflik utilitas, inspeksi keselamatan, dan koordinasi dengan proyek infrastruktur lainnya seperti pekerjaan air dan saluran pembuangan.

segments.src: Critics of the proposal warn that a rigid 120-day deadline does not account for the wide variation in review complexity across different jurisdictions.
segments.tr: Kritikus proposal ini memperingatkan bahwa batas waktu 120 hari yang kaku tidak memperhitungkan variasi luas dalam kompleksitas peninjauan di berbagai yurisdiksi.

segments.src: A small town with a part-time planning staff and a dense historic downtown may need more time to properly vet an application than a large city with a dedicated permitting department.
segments.tr: Kota kecil dengan staf perencanaan paruh waktu dan pusat kota bersejarah yang padat mungkin memerlukan lebih banyak waktu untuk memeriksa permohonan dengan benar dibandingkan kota besar dengan departemen perizinan khusus.

segments.src: Municipal advocates also worry that capping fees below what it actually costs a city to review applications and maintain public infrastructure could shift those costs onto local taxpayers instead of the companies benefiting from access to public property.
segments.tr: Para advokat kota juga khawatir bahwa membatasi biaya di bawah biaya sebenarnya yang dikeluarkan kota untuk meninjau permohonan dan memelihara infrastruktur publik dapat mengalihkan biaya tersebut kepada pembayar pajak lokal, alih-alih perusahaan yang mendapat manfaat dari akses ke properti publik.

segments.src: There is also a practical enforcement question.
segments.tr: Ada juga pertanyaan praktis mengenai penegakan hukum.

segments.src: If a permit is treated as automatically approved after 120 days regardless of whether a review was completed, some local officials fear that could reduce leverage to negotiate basic safeguards, such as requirements to repair streets after construction or coordinate work to avoid repeated digging in the same location.
segments.tr: Jika izin dianggap disetujui secara otomatis setelah 120 hari terlepas dari apakah peninjauan telah selesai atau belum, beberapa pejabat lokal khawatir hal itu dapat mengurangi daya tawar untuk menegosiasikan perlindungan dasar, seperti persyaratan untuk memperbaiki jalan setelah konstruksi atau mengoordinasikan pekerjaan untuk menghindari penggalian berulang di lokasi yang sama.

segments.src: ## The Industry Perspective
segments.tr: ## Perspektif Industri

segments.src: Telecom and broadband trade groups have generally welcomed the proposal, describing permitting delays as a genuine obstacle to closing the digital divide, especially in the context of federal and state programs designed to expand high-speed internet access to unserved areas.
segments.tr: Kelompok perdagangan telekomunikasi dan pita lebar umumnya menyambut baik proposal ini, menggambarkan penundaan perizinan sebagai hambatan nyata untuk menutup kesenjangan digital, terutama dalam konteks program federal dan negara bagian yang dirancang untuk memperluas akses internet berkecepatan tinggi ke daerah-daerah yang belum terlayani.

segments.src: They argue that in many cases, local reviews take far longer than necessary not because of legitimate complexity, but because of understaffed permitting offices, unclear application requirements, or, in some instances, an incentive to extract higher fees before granting approval.
segments.tr: Mereka berpendapat bahwa dalam banyak kasus, peninjauan lokal memakan waktu jauh lebih lama dari yang diperlukan bukan karena kompleksitas yang sah, tetapi karena kantor perizinan yang kekurangan staf, persyaratan permohonan yang tidak jelas, atau, dalam beberapa kasus, insentif untuk menarik biaya yang lebih tinggi sebelum memberikan persetujuan.

segments.src: Industry representatives point to the goals of federal broadband expansion initiatives, which set ambitious timelines for connecting unserved households, as evidence that a faster, more standardized permitting process is needed nationwide rather than left to the discretion of thousands of individual local governments.
segments.tr: Perwakilan industri menunjuk pada tujuan inisiatif perluasan pita lebar federal, yang menetapkan jadwal ambisius untuk menghubungkan rumah tangga yang belum terlayani, sebagai bukti bahwa proses perizinan yang lebih cepat dan lebih terstandarisasi diperlukan secara nasional daripada diserahkan pada kebijakan ribuan pemerintah daerah secara individu.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: The proposal is still working through the FCC's formal rulemaking process, which typically involves public comment periods where local governments, industry groups, and the public can weigh in before any final rule is adopted.
segments.tr: Proposal ini masih dalam proses pembuatan aturan formal FCC, yang biasanya melibatkan periode komentar publik di mana pemerintah daerah, kelompok industri, dan masyarakat dapat memberikan masukan sebelum aturan final diadopsi.

segments.src: Legal challenges are considered likely if a final rule is issued, given long-standing debates over the extent of federal authority to override local control of public rights-of-way.
segments.tr: Tantangan hukum dianggap mungkin terjadi jika aturan final diterbitkan, mengingat perdebatan panjang mengenai sejauh mana wewenang federal untuk mengesampingkan kendali lokal atas hak jalan umum.

segments.src: For now, the fight over the 120-day clock reflects a broader and recurring tension in U.S.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, pertarungan mengenai batas waktu 120 hari mencerminkan ketegangan yang lebih luas dan berulang di AS.

segments.src: infrastructure policy: balancing the goal of faster, more affordable broadband deployment against the traditional role of local governments in managing what happens on their own streets.
segments.tr: kebijakan infrastruktur: menyeimbangkan tujuan penyebaran pita lebar yang lebih cepat dan lebih terjangkau dengan peran tradisional pemerintah daerah dalam mengelola apa yang terjadi di jalan mereka sendiri.

segments.src: How that balance gets struck could shape not just how quickly new broadband lines get built, but who ultimately has a say in approving them.
segments.tr: Bagaimana keseimbangan itu dicapai dapat menentukan tidak hanya seberapa cepat kabel pita lebar baru dibangun, tetapi siapa yang pada akhirnya memiliki suara dalam menyetujuinya.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini ditujukan untuk tujuan informasi umum dan mencerminkan status proses pembuatan aturan federal yang diusulkan, yang dapat berubah seiring dengan peninjauan lebih lanjut.*

ja.title: 120日、すべての都市：ブロードバンド許可証に全国的な制限時間を設けるFCCの推進の裏側

segments.src: ## A National Deadline for Local Permits
segments.tr: ## 地域許可に対する全国的な期限

segments.src: The Federal Communications Commission is considering a sweeping change to how broadband infrastructure gets approved across the United States: a uniform 120-day "shot clock" that would require local and state governments to act on permit applications for telecom buildouts within that window, or risk having the permit considered automatically granted.
segments.tr: 連邦通信委員会（FCC）は、全米でのブロードバンドインフラの承認方法に関する根本的な変更を検討しています。それは、地方および州政府に対し、通信インフラの構築に関する許可申請に対してその期間内に処理を行うことを義務付け、そうしない場合は許可が自動的に下りたものとみなされる、一律120日の「ショット・クロック（期限）」です。

segments.src: The proposal would also cap the fees municipalities can charge companies to access public rights-of-way — the sidewalks, utility poles, and roadways where fiber lines and small-cell equipment are installed.
segments.tr: またこの提案では、自治体が企業から公共の通行権（ファイバーケーブルやスモールセル機器が設置される歩道、電柱、車道など）の利用料として徴収できる手数料の上限も設定されます。

segments.src: Federal officials backing the plan frame it as a response to a persistent complaint from telecom and internet providers: that inconsistent, sometimes years-long local review processes are one of the biggest bottlenecks slowing the rollout of faster, more reliable internet service, particularly in underserved and rural communities.
segments.tr: この計画を支持する連邦政府当局者は、これを通信事業者やインターネットプロバイダーからの根強い不満への対応として位置づけています。その不満とは、一貫性のない、時には何年もかかる地域の審査プロセスが、より高速で信頼性の高いインターネットサービスの普及、特にサービスが行き届いていない地域や地方コミュニティにおける普及を遅らせる最大のボトルネックの一つであるというものです。

segments.src: Supporters argue that a predictable national timeline would let companies plan builds with more certainty and reduce the cost of expansion, savings they say could eventually be passed on to consumers.
segments.tr: 支持者らは、予測可能な全国共通のタイムラインがあれば、企業はより確実性を持ってインフラ構築を計画でき、拡張コストを削減できると主張しており、その節約分は最終的に消費者への還元につながる可能性があるとしています。

segments.src: ## Why Cities Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## 都市が反発している理由

segments.src: Local governments and organizations representing them, including groups that speak for thousands of cities and counties nationwide, have raised strong objections.
segments.tr: 地方政府や、全国の数千の都市や郡を代弁する団体を含むそれらを代表する組織は、強い反対を表明しています。

segments.src: Their core argument is one of authority: rights-of-way have traditionally been managed locally because it is local officials who deal with the practical consequences of construction — torn-up streets, utility conflicts, safety inspections, and coordination with other infrastructure projects like water and sewer work.
segments.tr: 彼らの根本的な主張は権限の問題です。通行権は伝統的に地域で管理されてきました。なぜなら、掘り返された道路、ユーティリティの競合、安全点検、および水道や下水道工事などの他のインフラプロジェクトとの調整といった建設の実務上の結果に対処するのは、現地の当局者だからです。

segments.src: Critics of the proposal warn that a rigid 120-day deadline does not account for the wide variation in review complexity across different jurisdictions.
segments.tr: この提案の批判者たちは、厳格な120日の期限では、管轄区域ごとの審査の複雑さの大きな違いが考慮されていないと警告しています。

segments.src: A small town with a part-time planning staff and a dense historic downtown may need more time to properly vet an application than a large city with a dedicated permitting department.
segments.tr: 非常勤の計画担当スタッフを抱える歴史的建造物の密集した小さな町では、専任の許可部門を持つ大都市よりも、申請を適切に審査するためにより多くの時間が必要になる場合があります。

segments.src: Municipal advocates also worry that capping fees below what it actually costs a city to review applications and maintain public infrastructure could shift those costs onto local taxpayers instead of the companies benefiting from access to public property.
segments.tr: また、自治体の擁護派は、都市が実際に申請を審査し公共インフラを維持するためにかかるコストを下回るように手数料の上限を設定すると、公共財産へのアクセスの恩恵を受けている企業ではなく、地元の納税者にそのコストが転嫁される可能性があると懸念しています。

segments.src: There is also a practical enforcement question.
segments.tr: 実務的な執行に関する疑問もあります。

segments.src: If a permit is treated as automatically approved after 120 days regardless of whether a review was completed, some local officials fear that could reduce leverage to negotiate basic safeguards, such as requirements to repair streets after construction or coordinate work to avoid repeated digging in the same location.
segments.tr: 審査が完了したかどうかに関わらず120日後に許可が自動承認されたとみなされる場合、一部の地方当局者は、工事後の道路補修の義務付けや、同じ場所での度重なる掘削を避けるための工事調整といった基本的なセーフガードについて交渉するレバレッジが低下するのではないかと懸念しています。

segments.src: ## The Industry Perspective
segments.tr: ## 業界の視点

segments.src: Telecom and broadband trade groups have generally welcomed the proposal, describing permitting delays as a genuine obstacle to closing the digital divide, especially in the context of federal and state programs designed to expand high-speed internet access to unserved areas.
segments.tr: 通信およびブロードバンドの業界団体は概ねこの提案を歓迎しており、許可の遅延はデジタルデバイドを解消する上での真の障害であると述べています。特に、未提供地域への高速インターネットアクセスの拡大を目的とした連邦および州のプログラムの文脈においてはなおさらです。

segments.src: They argue that in many cases, local reviews take far longer than necessary not because of legitimate complexity, but because of understaffed permitting offices, unclear application requirements, or, in some instances, an incentive to extract higher fees before granting approval.
segments.tr: 彼らは、多くの場合における地域の審査が不必要に長期化しているのは、正当な複雑さのためではなく、人員不足の許可担当オフィス、不明確な申請要件、あるいは場合によっては承認を与える前に高額な手数料を引き出すインセンティブがあるためだと主張しています。

segments.src: Industry representatives point to the goals of federal broadband expansion initiatives, which set ambitious timelines for connecting unserved households, as evidence that a faster, more standardized permitting process is needed nationwide rather than left to the discretion of thousands of individual local governments.
segments.tr: 業界の代表者らは、未提供地域の世帯を接続するための野心的なタイムラインを設定している連邦のブロードバンド拡張イニシアチブの目標を挙げ、数千の個別の地方政府の裁量に委ねるのではなく、より迅速で標準化された許可プロセスが全国的に必要である証拠としています。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起きるのか

segments.src: The proposal is still working through the FCC's formal rulemaking process, which typically involves public comment periods where local governments, industry groups, and the public can weigh in before any final rule is adopted.
segments.tr: この提案は依然としてFCCの正式な規則制定プロセスの途上にあり、通常、これには最終規則が採択される前に地方政府、業界団体、および一般市民が意見を述べることができるパブリックコメント期間が含まれます。

segments.src: Legal challenges are considered likely if a final rule is issued, given long-standing debates over the extent of federal authority to override local control of public rights-of-way.
segments.tr: 公共通行権の地方自治に対する連邦権限の範囲をめぐる長年の議論を考慮すると、最終規則が発令された場合、法的な争いが発生することは確実視されています。

segments.src: For now, the fight over the 120-day clock reflects a broader and recurring tension in U.S.
segments.tr: 現時点では、120日間の期限をめぐる争いは、米国のインフラ政策におけるより広範で繰り返し現れる緊張関係を反映しています。

segments.src: infrastructure policy: balancing the goal of faster, more affordable broadband deployment against the traditional role of local governments in managing what happens on their own streets.
segments.tr: それは、より速く手頃な価格のブロードバンド展開という目標と、自らの街で何が起こるかを管理する地方政府の伝統的な役割とのバランスを取ることです。

segments.src: How that balance gets struck could shape not just how quickly new broadband lines get built, but who ultimately has a say in approving them.
segments.tr: そのバランスがどのように取られるかによって、新しいブロードバンド回線がどれだけ早く建設されるだけでなく、最終的に誰がその承認に発言権を持つかが形作られる可能性があります。
